exact_obstruction.principle: Complex-isogenous elliptic curves have isomorphic rational endomorphism algebras, hence the same CM field.

scope_warning: This rejects only direct transport by identifying/isogenizing the J2 normalization or E' with a Shioda-Mor Mitani elliptic factor of Kc. It does not reject a more general K3-level Shioda-Inose correspondence or direct B-field/cycle evaluation.

source_locks.shioda_mitani_formula: For Q=(a,b,c), tau=(-b+sqrt(D))/(2a), A_Q=E_tau x E_(a*tau+b), D=b^2-4ac.
